thread:
Maria (AE): Hey team, LondonBank SIG arrived. They want itemized evidence mapped to each SIG question for our Private (on-prem) flow. Main blockers: KMS/HSM custody, network isolation diagrams, and vulnerability scanning cadence. Can we triage who's owning which Q blocks?

Priya (Solutions Eng): I can own the KMS/HSM and network isolation pieces. Will produce a Q-by-Q mapping sheet and attach artifacts. ETA today EOD.

Sam (Security Eng): Quick clarifying q: do they require BYOK with customer HSM, or just customer-managed KMS keys in their VPC? Jorge, did they state that in the questionnaire?

Jorge (LondonBank): They asked "Key custody: customer vs vendor" and flagged HSM for highest-risk systems. Prefer customer HSM but asked if Redwood supports HSM integration for Private.

Priya (Solutions Eng): We do support customer-managed KMS in Private. HSM integrations require additional ops work — we support bring-your-own HSM via KMS integration with our on-prem box. I'll note the exact controls and include the KMS flow diagram.

Claire (Sales Eng): For the SIG spreadsheet, can you add columns: question_id, answer_snippet, artifact_name, artifact_link, evidence_owner? That format made legal + risk happy on the last deal.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Yup. I'll populate with QIDs they highlighted: Q14 (key custody), Q23 (network segregation), Q41 (patching cadence), Q56 (vuln scanning + SCA). Sample row:

```
Q14 | We support customer-managed KMS; optional HSM integration via BYOHSM | redwood/private-kms-integration.pdf | https://internal.docs/redwood/private-kms-integration.pdf | Priya
```

Sam (Security Eng): For Q41/Q56, I'll attach our quarterly vuln scan report and weekly SCA snapshot. Note: vuln scan for Private is the customer-deployed scanner; we provide scan configs and remediation SLAs.

Maria (AE): Thanks. Ops: any audits or SOC docs we can point them to for operational controls?

OpsBot: Document uploaded: "SOC2-Type2-Summary-2025.pdf" to /shared/sales/evidence/1723456789/ (link: https://files.redwood/sales/1723456789/SOC2-Type2-Summary-2025.pdf) :white_check_mark:

Sam (Security Eng): Adding PCI/NIST crosswalk is unnecessary unless banking asks specifically, but include SOC2 and our internal control matrix. I'll add a short narrative for Q9 (access controls) showing RBAC + AD sync.

Jorge (LondonBank): Can you confirm encryption-at-rest algorithm used for on-disk data? They want AES-256 or equivalent.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Confirmed AES-256-GCM for at-rest. I'll add the config snippet and where it's enforced in the deployment templates (k8s secret encryption + disk-level LUKS for on-prem nodes).

Claire (Sales Eng): Pricing ask from procurement: if they require HSM integration, is there a separate engineering runbook/pricing line item we should tee up? We need a short answer for procurement today.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Yes — HSM integration is a professional services add-on: estimated 4-6 weeks eng + ops, one-time setup fee + minor monthly support premium. I'll draft a one-liner for procurement.

Maria (AE): Perfect. Ownership recap: Priya -> KMS/HSM + network diagrams + Q-by-Q sheet; Sam -> vuln scans + access controls narrative; Claire -> procurement one-liner + packaging; Maria -> consolidate + send to LondonBank.

Sam (Security Eng): FYI I'll redact any customer-sensitive data from sample scans before sharing.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Uploading draft sheet now: https://sheets.redwood/s/1AbCde/1723456789 (permissions: sales+security view). I'll flag rows with missing artifacts.

Maria (AE): Received. I'll review after EOD and start the email thread to LondonBank legal with attachments. Thx all :pray:.

Jorge (LondonBank): Appreciate the quick turnaround. If possible, can you also include a short operational runbook for key rotation? They asked about rotation cadence.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Will include rotation policy: default 90 days for workload keys, 365 days for master keys (customer-configurable). Add to Q14 artifact.

OpsBot: Reminder: evidence package zip will be auto-generated at 1723457600 and uploaded to /shared/sales/evidence/1723456789/package.zip

Claire (Sales Eng): Great — once package is up I'll send the procurement one-liner and the SOW draft.

Maria (AE): Closing loop: if anything blocks EOD ping me directly.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Noted. Signing off to finish diagrams.

Sam (Security Eng): Signing off after scrub of scans.

Jorge (LondonBank): Thanks team.
